obligations.summary: The fixed JFIF grayscale, 4:4:4, 4:2:2 and 4:2:0 fixtures probe deterministically to their exact qualified single-frame source facts.
Preflight authority is deterministic and fully bounded for all four qualified baseline modes, with exact operation peaks and caller-owned encoded-byte coexistence.
Each fixed JPEG decodes deterministically to its independently frozen libjpeg-turbo tight RGB8 payload.
Encoded-byte, format, dimension and pixel limits fail closed for every qualified fixture before a successful packed value can be published.
The public one-shot slice accepts only exact full-size fit, convert-to-sRGB, standard-dynamic-range requests across the finite baseline JFIF union and rejects nearby alternatives.
For each qualified baseline mode, a factory configured one byte below that fixture's exact operation peak rejects both resource admission and packed decode.
